Wall climbing and drone-based robotic solutions to automatically assess the circular potential embodied in a building. The solutions will be based on the robotic wall-climbing robotic platform (TRL-2) and commercial drone and sensor solutions.

The Disassembly Robot End-Effector is an innovation (Level 4) designed to dismantle construction products, such as windows, to maximize material recovery while reducing operational costs, energy consumption, and human error. Currently at a TRL of 6-7, the technology builds upon existing vacuum and gripper designs and has been validated on 3D-printed windows. Future development plans include validation with aluminum-framed windows and a collaboration with Ragn-Sells to adapt the system for wooden-framed windows.
